chapters.title: A Place on the Grid
chapters.briefing: Rain on the viaduct, engines under it. Mara Venn walks you in — Dax does not take strangers seriously until they have won something.
chapters.victoryLine: Dax nods once. That is the whole conversation. It is enough.

chapters.title: No Borrowed Reputation
chapters.briefing: Ivo Renn does not do trash talk. He runs a clean line and expects you to keep up or get out of the way.
chapters.victoryLine: Ivo says nothing. He is already recalculating your line for next time.

chapters.title: Workshop Hours
chapters.briefing: Same driver, same question: was Foundry Shift luck? Ivo wants the real answer.
chapters.victoryLine: First real word from Ivo Renn: "Again." From him, that is respect.

chapters.title: Know Every Corner
chapters.briefing: Sel Arden is vouching for you with Signal Red, staking her own name on it. Do not make her regret it.
chapters.victoryLine: Sel does not celebrate. She just tells Signal Red you are theirs now.

chapters.title: An Honest Measure
chapters.briefing: Open road, open throttle — and word is out. Someone is asking who is climbing the ranks this fast.
chapters.victoryLine: Sel clocks the time and says it flat: "You are not quiet anymore."

chapters.title: The Late Entry
chapters.briefing: Reya Voss does not race for REP. She races because losing in public is the one thing money cannot fix.
chapters.victoryLine: Reya loses gracefully in front of everyone who matters to her — and never forgives you for making her do it there.

chapters.title: Names on the Board
chapters.briefing: Ivo Renn is watching from the ring’s edge tonight. Wren does not like being anyone’s undercard.
chapters.victoryLine: Wren steps back. Ivo steps forward. Some things were always going to end up between the two of you.

chapters.title: Afterdark: Nova City Final
chapters.briefing: Sel Arden gets you through the door. Every crew you have raced is watching. Ivo Renn is waiting.
chapters.victoryLine: Afterdark Champion. Ivo does not say "again" this time — he says your name.
